notes.title: March 22, 2024 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
3/22/2024:
[olist]
 Implemented Post-case materials for each scenario in The 4th Floor casefile which is accessible after aceing the case file.
 Added an introductory text at the beginning to better inform players of the nature of the game.
 Changed the Grading system so players pass the exam with a grade of A to coincide with the addition of the post-case materials.
 Added/tweaked clues in the game's last casefile,' Hughes Manor Feud ', to improve players' investigative experience. Additionally, introduced an extra question to further assist players in their investigation process.
 Improved object rotation and implemented a supplementary method utilizing the WASD keys.
 Improved/fixed text for French, German, Spain Spanish, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese and Korean for all case files.
 Removed numbers on the side of the Phone/Computer UI to avoid misunderstandings and provide a smoother game experience.
 Implemented a warning during key bind customization when players choose a key already in use.
 Implemented an automatic save when players load the Preliminary Trial at the start of the game.
 Fixed other minor bugs
[/olist]

As always if you face any issues please let us know in the Bug Reports / Technical Help forums or via our email at contact@eqstudios.com.

notes.title: December 21, 2023 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
12/21/2023:
[olist]
 Implemented 'Case File Report' which can be unlocked when players aced the respective case file. This is a summary of how the crime played out and allows players to cross check their hypothesis of the crime scene.

 Implemented 'Game Mode'. Players will be able to choose between Assisted Mode and Detective Mode. Assisted mode inform players whether their submitted answers are correct or incorrect. Detective Mode is the current default mode of the game where no help is provided.

 Implemented player-submitted results when selecting 'The 4th Floor' and 'Missing' scenarios. Players can now view the results for each individual scenario respectively.

 Controller input for answers should be fixed, if you are still having issues with your answers not being registered while using a controller/steam deck please send us an email with information about your peripherals to "contact@eqstudios.com."

 Other small bugs.

 Fixed Japanese language text for Bloodbath. Fixed Korean language text for all case files. Fixed Brazilian Portuguese language text for the game A.I.

[/olist]

We will update the "previousversion" build to the Dec 8, build in 7 days, so that those who are facing any issues can test to see if they are resolved. 

As always if you face any issues please let us know in the Bug Reports / Technical Help forums or via our email at contact@eqstudios.com.

notes.title: Release Date Update
notes.notes:
Hello, aspiring investigators!

As we approach the end of Q3, you’re likely wondering why Scene Investigators has not announced an exact release date yet. Unfortunately, we are posting this update to inform you of a minor delay in release!

Although our goal was to release during Q3, some critical development processes required to achieve the quality we are aiming for are taking longer than anticipated. We have tried our best to make the previously announce release window and held off on announcing a delay with the hope of not needing to. Alas, the time has come to make it official: Scene Investigators is launching in early Q4.

We deeply apologize for this delay and any inconvenience caused. We are incredibly grateful for your patience and hope you will enjoy the game when it releases!


Sincerely,
EQ Studios
